The proposed Appeal has been filed
by the com plainant against the judgment
dated 30.04.2022, passed by learned
Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate/ Civil
Judge (Senior Division), Roorkee, District
Haridwar in Com plaint Case No.1076 of
2021, by which, the learned trial court
has acquitted the respondent no.2 from
the offence punishable under Section
138 of the Negotiable I nstruments Act,
1881.
2 . The proposed Appeal has been filed
along with an Application under Section
378(4) of the Code of Criminal
Procedure, 1973.
3 . Heard Mr. Tapan Singh, learned
counsel for the proposed appellant and
Mr. Rakesh Negi, learned Brief Holder for
State.
4 . Respondent no.2 is not present.
5 . Mr. Tapan Singh, Advocate, has
contended that the respondent no.2-
accused has adm itted his signature on

the cheque. He further submitted that
the dem and notice was sent to the
correct address of the accused.
6 . The Application for Leave to Appeal,
filed under Section 378(4) of the code of
Criminal Procedure, 1973 is allowed. The
proposed appellant-com plainant is
granted special leave to appeal from the
order of acquittal of the respondent
no.2-accused.
7 . Admit.
8 . I ssue fresh notice to the respondent
no.2.
9 . Steps to be taken within a week.
1 0 . List on 20.12.2024.
1 1 . The Registry is directed to delete
the nam e of Mr. R.P. Singh, Advocate in
the next cause list.
